parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request.

parameters.name: DocumentCode
parameters.description: The document number of the registrant. The number cannot exceed 50 characters in length.

parameters.name: DocumentImage
parameters.description: The document image of the registrant (Base64-encoded). The original file size must be between 50 KB and 3 MB.

parameters.name: DocumentType
parameters.description: The document type of the registrant. For more information, see the appendix on document types.

parameters.name: Email
parameters.description: The email address. The address cannot exceed 300 characters in length.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the registrant. The name cannot exceed 255 characters in length.

parameters.name: Phone
parameters.description: The phone number of the registrant. The number cannot exceed 128 characters in length. If the country is China and the number is not a mobile phone number, the area code must match the city.

parameters.name: RegistrantId
parameters.description: The ID of the real-name registrant.
